returns.name: Form WTH-10001, Oklahoma Quarterly Wage Withholding Tax Return
contents: Filed on a quarterly basis with any payment due, on or before the 20th day of the month following the close of each quarter (OAC 710:90-3-4), even when there is no payroll for the period.
The OTC compares quarterly withholding returns with the W-2/W-3 yearly totals filed with the IRS.

returns.name: Annual reconciliation (W-3 information) to the Oklahoma Tax Commission
contents: HB 2289 (68 O.S. 2385.3) imposes a penalty of up to $1,000 on an employer who fails to furnish the Tax Commission the required annual reconciliation by January 31.
